programme.desc: Viajes de Lujo lleva a los espectadores a destinos mágicos y lujosos, explorando historia, arte y cultura.

programme.title: S.O.S Jardines
programme.desc: El contratista Brian McCourt y la diseñadora Sarah Keenleyside crean patios traseros personalizados.

programme.title: S.O.S Jardines
programme.desc: El contratista Brian McCourt y la diseñadora Sarah Keenleyside crean patios traseros personalizados.

programme.title: Flipping Virgins
programme.desc: La experta Egypt Sherrod guía a novatos que arriesgan todo al renovar casas con decisiones bajo presión.

programme.title: Flipping Virgins
programme.desc: La experta Egypt Sherrod guía a novatos que arriesgan todo al renovar casas con decisiones bajo presión.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: Un hiver à Central Park
programme.desc: L'histoire d'une femme confrontée à la mort de sa fille en bas âge, tout en essayant de préserver son mariage et sa relation avec son beau-fils.

programme.title: Hotel new hampshire
programme.desc: Durant l'été 1939, Win Berry et sa future épouse Mary achètent un ours brun et une moto à un garçon nommé Freud. Plusieurs années après, Win et Mary, parents de 5 enfants, décident de restaurer une vieille bâtisse pour y établir un hôtel, le « New-Hampshire ».

programme.title: Un quartier totalement wouf!
programme.desc: Alors que tout le monde est parti en voyage de ski, le voisin de Robert engage deux voleurs ineptes pour voler sa dernière invention. Les chiens du voisinage utiliseront les inventions de Robert pour créer une maison des horreurs pour les voleurs.

programme.title: Marcher vers l'Amour
programme.desc: Lorsque son musée d'art fait face à des problèmes financiers, une conservatrice conventionnelle collabore avec un artiste d'avant-garde pour créer une exposition hors du commun. Elle apprend à sortir des sentiers battus pour sauver le musée et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: La retraite de l'amour
programme.desc: Lorsque la marque de beauté Bloom décide de se concentrer sur les ventes en ligne, Jenny doit trouver comment vivre dans l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle , tandis que Nate a déjà trouvé la solution. Lorsque des étincelles jaillissent entre eux, un seul problème se pose : c’est le frère de son patron...

programme.title: Une Mère Diabolique
programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Lors des funérailles, elle est choquée de rencontrer sa mère biologique, Jessica. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.title: La dernière chance
programme.desc: Un agent du FBI doit négocier avec une femme qui prend un hôpital en otage afin de mettre la main sur un médicament expérimental.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Catherine rencontre Nick, un veuf, qu'elle épouse et avec qui elle emménage. Des choses étranges commencent à lui arriver dans son appartement. Est-elle en train de l'imaginer ou...

programme.title: My life is murder s1
programme.desc: Intrépide et espiègle, elle agit par instinct ; à la fois ange vengeur et un peu provocatrice ; profondément empathique et franche à en être parfois impolie. Elle possède aussi un sens de l’humour irrévérencieux. À part le fait que son mari est décédé il y a quelques années, peu de gens savent grand-chose sur Alexa ou sur les raisons pour lesquelles elle a quitté la police, faisant d’elle un véritable mystère. Et Alexa ne peut pas résister à un mystère, alors lorsque son ancien collègue et ami de longue date, l’inspecteur Kieran Hussey, lui demande de consulter sur ses affaires les plus complexes, elle semble hésitante. Mais en réalité, elle ne peut pas dire non. Pour résoudre l’insolvable, Alexa est accompagnée de Madison, pétillante, sarcastique, ambitieuse et terre-à-terre. Véritable extravertie, Madison travaille comme analyste de données pour la police et répond toujours présente lorsque Alexa fait appel à ses talents.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en Toscane
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain en herbe suit un titan littéraire souffrant du blocage des écrivains jusqu'à son refuge dans l'Italie rurale et découvre la vie et l'amour du génie irascible et de ses filles.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

Ever the adventurer, Ellis dives into a lake that, according to local legend, is full of mysteries and monsters.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.sub-title: My Pacific Quest S01 E05 - The Marshall Islands
programme.desc: The Marshall Islands have a long human history, but it is the more recent saga that was thrust upon them during World War II and its aftermath that draws host Ellis Emmett to its shores. Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest

programme.desc: For thousands of years, the island peoples of the Pacific were masters of the ocean, sailing across the waves in handmade canoes and navigating by the stars. But, these traditional ways and sailing knowledge are being lost to technology. Host Ellis Emmett helps get a traditional canoe back on the water, and sees first-hand how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.

programme.desc: This special documentary examines Inspector Barnaby - his methods and techniques of investigation, from his time in the original novels through his translation to television.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Fletcher's Cross are preparing for their team match against Midsomer Worthy. Tara Cavendish, the second wife of local landowner and cricket captain Robert Cavendish, has since gone missing after taking their dog for a walk. When her body is later discovered nearby in a disused quarry, with the weapon, a cricket bat lying, next to her.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Alice Bly arrives at Lawnside, a nursing home in Aspern Tallow to rest after having hospital treatment. She soon suspects something is not right when a fellow resident dies the night after her arrival. It is also discovered that the lady's valuable Cartier watch has also gone missing. Alice's nephew DCI Barnaby agrees to look into things despite having a week's leave. It is not long before two more deaths quickly follow the first and a mysterious visitor is seen lurking around at night.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Mallow are preparing for the 'Perfect English Village' competition even though a few days earlier saw the murder of local thief and lothario, Peter Drinkwater (Orlando Bloom). Barnaby and Troy discover that he had been stabbed with a pitchfork while squatting at an abandoned farm. The detectives must deduce if one of his burglary victims, his accomplice in the robberies or another disgruntled villager may have been the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly before his retirement, Superintendent Pringle arrests a local poacher for the murder of a tramp during a fox hunt in woodland close to the village of Upper Marshwood. DCI Barnaby is unsure that the poacher was the killer. Upon returning from holidaying in France, Barnaby is proved right, when the poacher's father is murdered with his own shotgun. As they reopen the investigation, they find many hidden secrets amongst the villagers.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of a local beauty is discovered by the pool at her manor house, Barnaby and Troy uncover a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in Setwale Wood, an apparent suicide, except that her suicide note is emailed after her body has already been sighted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton, when they hear about a house called Winyard; a tumbledown cottage in the woods. At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Weltnaturerbe Costa Rica: Guanacaste Nationalpark
programme.desc: Entdecken Sie mit der 3D-Serie „Weltnaturerbe Mittelamerika“ den Guanacaste Nationalpark. Eröffnet am 9. Juli 1991 zieht er sich von der Küste des Pazifiks durch riesige Mangrovenwälder hinein in den tropischen Regenwald Costa Ricas. Die Dokumentation Weltnaturerbe Costa Rica 3D - Guanacaste Nationalpark bietet Urwald pur. Folgen Sie den Pfaden von Leguanen, giftigen Schlangen und Kapuzineräffchen. Genießen Sie die Farbenpracht und Artenvielfalt einer außergewöhnlichen und faszinierenden Flora. Es gibt auch viel Wissenswertes zu entdecken. Spannender Höhepunkt der Expedition in den Regenwald: die Begegnung mit einem der letzten indigenen Völker unserer Erde. Die Maleku leben seit Jahrhunderten im Einklang mit der Natur des Dschungels und pflegen diese Tradition bis heute. 1999 wurde das rund 100.000 Hektar umfassende Areal zum Weltnaturerbe der UNESCO erklärt. Es umfasst die drei Nationalparks Santa Rosa, Rincion de la Vieja und – Guanacaste. In den unterschiedlichen Lebensräumen zwischen Pazifikküste, 2000 Meter hoher Bergwelt und karibischem Tiefland gedeihen über 230.000 Tier- und Pflanzenarten. Das Trockenwaldgebiet des Guanacaste Nationalparks ist zusammen mit dem des Santa Rosa Nationalparks das größte Trockenreservat in Costa Rica. Rund 60.000 Hektar misst es. Auf den ersten Blick wirkt der Park besonders in der kahlen und feuergefährdeten Trockenzeit wenig einladend, aber gerade dann ist das Beobachten von Tieren an ihren Wasser- und Futterstellen am besten möglich. Mit ein bisschen Glück bekommt man hier Nasenbären, Pumas, Jaguare, Pekaris, Faultiere, Gürteltiere und Königsgeier zu sehen.

programme.title: Highway Heat

programme.title: The Quiet Hour
programme.desc: Aliens haben den Planeten Erde überfallen, töten erbarmungslos dessen Bewohner und vernichten sämtliche natürlichen Ressourcen. Der noch verbliebene Teil der Menschheit hungert und mutiert zu eiskalten Plünderern. Verzweifelt kämpft Sarah in dieser apokalyptischen Zeit, um den Hof ihrer Familie und die Solaranlage, die die gewalttätigen Aliens zurückhält.

programme.title: Tödliches Verlangen
programme.desc: Angela (Gina Gershon) und Brian (Nicolas Cage) leben den amerikanischen Traum in einem luxuriösen Traumhaus mit Pool. Umgeben von attraktiven Freunden scheint auch ihr privates Glück fast perfekt. Nur der sehnliche Wunsch nach einer kinderreichen Familie bleibt unerfüllt. Deshalb soll die hübsche Katie (Nicky Whelan) als Leihmutter für das zweite Kind diese Lücke füllen. Doch schon bald entsteht eine beunruhigende Spannung aus sexuellem Verlangen und Eifersucht und Angela ahnt, dass Katie ein dunkles Geheimnis hütet. Ein abgründiges Katz- und Maus-Spiel setzt sich in Gang und droht das Glück von Angela und Brian zu zerstören...

programme.title: Angel - I Will Find You
programme.desc: Die verstorbene Francesca (Angela Sarafyan) kehrt zurück auf die Erde und zieht als Engel durch die Welt der Lebenden. Sie ist verantwortlich dafür, dass die Menschen, die sie trifft anschließend entweder ein glücklicheres Leben führen oder aber ein baldiges tragisches Ende im Tod finden. Dabei darf sie sich jedoch nie auf eine emotionale Bindung einlassen. Dies erschwert ihre geheime Suche nach dem Menschen, den sie noch immer liebt und von dem sie sich zu Lebzeiten nie richtig verabschieden konnte...

programme.title: Astral City
programme.desc: Als der Arzt Dr. André Luiz seine Augen aufschlägt, muss er erkennen, dass er tot ist. In einer bedrohlich wirkenden Wüste beginnt seine abenteuerliche Reise. Bald betritt er dort die mysteriöse Astral City, die die Einwohner als ihr Heim bezeichnen. Er scheint nicht im Himmel angekommen zu sein, sondern in einer spirituellen Dimension. Luiz ist also nicht am Ende seiner Reise angekommen, sondern vielmehr am Anfang. Ein Meisterwerk des brasilianischen Kinos voller atemberaubender Effekte!

programme.title: The Idealist - Geheimakte Grönland
programme.desc: Im Januar 1968 stürzt ein amerikanischer B52-Bomber über dänischem Hoheitsgebiet im grönländischen Thule nahe eines US-Luftwaffenstützpunktes ab und wird kurz darauf als Atomunfall deklariert. Die Verantwortlichen beteuern, die Situation unter Kontrolle zu haben. Nach den acht Monate andauernden und aufwendigen Aufräumarbeiten sind das Flugzeugwrack sowie das mit Plutonium kontaminierte Gletschereis beseitigt und der Fall wird zu den Akten gelegt. Erst dem Journalisten Poul Brink fallen 18 Jahre danach Ungereimtheiten auf. Unter der Eiskappe in Grönland und in den Archiven der US-Regierung scheint die bittere Wahrheit über den Absturz zu liegen. Also beginnt der ehrgeizige Reporter mit der Recherche und zieht dabei allzu bald die Aufmerksamkeit der Verantwortlichen des Unfalls auf sich – und die sehen seine ersten erfolgreichen Enthüllungen gar nicht gern...

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: La Discusión con Atanasio la dejó muy mal parada. Atanasio dijo que no tenía nada que contarle a ella | que iba a esperar que llegara Briggite y lo resolvería a ese nivel. Juan Diego la invita a un café para que le cuente a él. Carolina ya está obstinada de esperar a Juan Diego. Segundo llega en su taxi nuevo y la lleva. Juan Diego trata de tranquilizar a Yubiri y esta ya ni se acuerda del problema. Carolina se va con Segundo y este le dice que van a ir a una panadería a comer cachitos.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 207: Corazon Roto, Sospechas y Maternidad
programme.desc: Santiago está borracho y escuchando mariachi por el corazón roto, pero repentinamente llega Egleé para desahogarse porque cree que es mala madre. Por un momento Aristiguieta sospecha que Felicita y Gonzalo estuvieron juntos de viaje en Orlando.

programme.title: Episodio 7
programme.desc: La red de mentiras asfixia a Ricardo, quien sucumbe a su obsesión y vuelve a hacerle el amor a Celia, traicionando a Manuela tras firmar un importante contrato. Paralelamente, Gustavo toca fondo con su adicción a las drogas y es internado de emergencia en Hogares Crea. Mientras los enredos amorosos entre Marcelo y Verónica se complican, el terror se apodera de Manuela: una escalofriante llamada anónima con la voz de Celia regresa para atormentarla y quebrar su aparente felicidad.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: En la cena, Amalia interroga a Rosa sobre su familia, abriendo la herida de la muerte de Carlos; Rosa pide regresar a la residencia. Adolfo discute con Maricela hasta amenazas de divorcio. Isaías, despechado, se desahoga con Erasto, quien finge ayudarlo. Adolfo visita a Consuelo y le declara su amor, pero ella lo rechaza endurecida. Arévalo informa a Maricela sobre el pasado de Consuelo. Junior visita a Rosa sorprendiéndola en la cocina de Blanca, complicando aún más su frente sentimental ante los rumores de la residencia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo tiene un cruce con Irene tras aparecer en la empresa y poner nerviosa a Virginia quien acaba de ser recientemente contratada como secretaria de Carlos Ernesto. Toni trata de explicarle a María Lucía su situación con Oriana, quien aparece en las oficinas para hablar con Leonardo, pero sin éxito ella decide terminar la relación. Agustina obliga a Rebeca a quedarse en casa finalizando sus tareas por haber faltado al colegio a pesar de estar enferma. Discutiendo con Coromoto por contradecir sus decisiones tomadas respecto a la niña. Maribel decide plantear a su jefe que le restituyan su puesto de secretaria tras una disputa con sus viejas compañeras de trabajo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Reina discuten en el hospital y Sol le promete que se vengará de ella y de lo que le hizo. Ricarda se encuentra feliz de que su hija está viva. Al día siguiente va con el comisario Tavares y la policía al campamento de los maleantes que tiene secuestrada a Giselle y Tavares los reduce uno a uno. Eloy le dice a Columba que no puede divorciarse de Reina. Aída se da cuenta de que le cambiaron su bebé con el de Sol y acusa a Reina en su cara. Reina la golpea y la amenaza.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucia busca consuelo en Sandra por el fin de su relación con Leo. Pero al volver a su hogar, descubre una peor noticia mientras Zulay y Trinidad discuten, la de no ser hija biológica de su madre. Llena de incertidumbre y furia se va de su casa decidida a alejarse de todos, con Ricardo que aparece en el momento justo para ayudarla. Leo quiere resarcirse por la discusión previa, pero al llegar a su casa ya no la encuentra. Carlos Ernesto encuentra una carta de Rebeca Ferrándiz previa a su muerte, donde queda en duda si ella ya sabía su destino. La abogada de la familia Ferrándiz notifica al representante de los Gutiérrez por el pedido al tribunal de una revisión ante la decisión sobre la libertad de Virginia.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída sabe que el bebé que tiene no es de ella y que Reina lo intercambió por el de Sol. La situación la tiene muy mal y no puede hacer nada porque Reina la tiene amenazada y la acusa de ser su cómplice. Sol y Heriberto han decidido casarse e irse a vivir junto bajo el mismo techo. Sol se entera de que la mansión de los Monserrat antiguamente pertenecía a los Figueras y por lo tanto ahora le pertenece a ella. Sol, está decidida a recuperar lo que le corresponde. Eloy y Columba se pelean.

programme.desc: Gabriela, una niña de once años, hija de un futbolista, es secuestrada durante el Mundial de Fútbol por un grupo de terroristas. Rafael, exdiputado de la Brigada Antisecuestros, tiene la tarea de resolver el caso y salvar a la niña de la forma más rápida y discreta posible. Durante la investigación, Rafael descubre que el grupo también pretende volar el Maracaná.

programme.title: Frente à Frente
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong é um oficial da Unidade Regional de Crime que trabalhou na frente durante muitos anos. O seu protegido, Yau Kong-ngo, respeita-o e consegue chegar até ele. No entanto, o destino coloca-os uns contra os outros.

programme.title: El Golpe
programme.desc: Dos delincuentes de poca monta y amigos desde hace mucho tiempo, Deuce y Chucky, se gradúan de robar casas de empeño y joyerías y se involucran en un plan para robar una bóveda de la mafia. Son reclutados con un grupo de delincuentes de poca monta por Gerry The Frenchman Ouimette, la mano derecha del jefe de Providence Mafia, Raymond Patriarca. Patriarca es un notorio gángster y verdugo que, aunque está en la cárcel, continúa dirigiendo su imperio criminal desde el interior de su bien equipada celda. El equipo lleva a cabo el mayor atraco en la historia de Estados Unidos: robar más de $ 30 millones de la bóveda de un comerciante de pieles que la mafia usa como su banco no oficial para almacenar efectivo y bienes robados. Cuando todas las personas que participaron en el atraco comienzan a morir, los dos amigos deben tratar de mantenerse con vida para contar la historia.

programme.title: O Justiceiro
programme.desc: Mestre em artes marciais e lutador, Kung Wei, vive numa casa humilde, com a esposa que está muito doente e com Johnny, seu filho que o adora e segue seus ensinamentos morais e de artes marciais. Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: AmeriCarna

When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

programme.title: Super Retriever

At the same time, the excitement continues on the dock as fun-loving canine athletes compete for their own Crown victories in SRS Super Dock.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Massive wildfires had consumed thousands of acres across the Bighorn Mountains and the neighboring foothills. Would the annual HuntStand pronghorn camp be a total bust, or would the crew be able to find a few animals beyond the smoke?

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.sub-title: "Second Chance | Hunting the November Rut in Ohio"
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E11 - Bear
programme.desc: We bears live a solitary life but when it comes to hunting we take it as a reunion. We love to catch and eat fish in the river where we spend a lot of our time but the forest is also our home. We have a lot of animal neighbours such as buffalos, seagulls, coyotes but we never really like to meet with wolves. Everyone is a bit different, because everyone lives differently. That’s why it is better not mingle with others and stay with your own kind.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E12 - Budgie
programme.desc: We budgies live in Australia. Here you’ll find everything that budgerigars need: open and broad plains; lakes; rivers; and mainly thousands and thousands of budgerigar friends. I don’t know, but it’s a beautiful life. I like it. Eating grass seeds and chatting with our other beautiful friends makes me happy.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E13 - Cat
programme.desc: Wild cats and domestic cats are all born the same way but their way of life is a bit different. Wild cats eat what they catch. But domestic cats get food from humans. Domestic cats don’t have to hunt anymore. This wild cat lives all alone. She must find some hideout against bad weather and predators without any help. Domestic cats like the presence of human and a comfortable home. What is better?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E39 - A Century Of The Queen Mother 100 Years In 100 Minutes
programme.desc: 100 years of celebration in 100 minutes

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E01 - Koala
programme.desc: This series is a unique look at the early life and development of young animals, edited and narrated from the viewpoint of the animal's themselves. As children explore the wonders of animal life, their natural fascination will deepen into a true love and appreciation of animals. In the first episode we meet Koala.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E02 - Gazelle
programme.desc: We gazelles live on the Savannah in Africa. Mummy said, that the Savannah is a very dry place. My dad has big horns so he can fight to protect us because lions want to eat us. We must be careful even by the river because crocodiles are watching. We eat mainly dry grass and if its not too dry we don’t need to drink much.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E03 - Sea Lion
programme.desc: We live in the ocean! It’s huge and wet. But mainly we live on the ocean shore. That’s where all the seal families make their home. What we love the most is swimming! Water is the greatest fun in the world. We have no problem staying in the water for hours at a time. Together with dolphins, we love to jump into the waves. Look at us go! Isn’t that awesome?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E04 - Brumby
programme.desc: I am a wild horse who lives in Australia. We were born to run and the difference between me and a farm horse is that I can run freely where I want. I meet with my friends the donkeys and lizards at waterholes which are very precious for us. But watch out! We don’t like to be pushed around or feel threatened.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E05 - Butterfly
programme.desc: We Monarch Butterflies have to chew our way from our egg to see the world. Bite by bite together, with my brothers and sisters we start to feed on the leaves. We don’t have any parents but just know what to do. When we feel cold, hungry, or afraid, we feel the same way as you do. We travel a lot and are capable of eating much more than our own weight. Our life is definitely hard work.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: When Andrew and Sarah Ferguson tied the knot, she soon became one of the most popular women to be called the Duchess of York since the title was created back in 1385.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E14 - Dingo
programme.desc: Hello, I’m little dingo and my mummy will tell me the story of how I was born and how I live. Here we go - Once upon a time, in a country far, far away, called Australia......a huge and mysterious bird brought the soul of a little dingo down to the Earth......into his mummy’s tummy... and how did it continue? Listen to the whole story.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E15 - Clownfish
programme.desc: I love swimming around and playing in the waters of our tropical ocean. There is so much to explore and many colours and shapes. We live in the Sea Anemone and have a glossy coat. The Clown Fish has only three stripes on an orange body but some of our relatives have lots of stripes. Sometimes I like to look at the other fish but I think that the striped ones are the prettiest.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E16 - Cheetah
programme.desc: We are the fastest runners in the world. We hunt our dinner and when we do we can run only for a short distance, we must catch something fast; otherwise we have to stop. If we don’t stop we can overheat, and that’s a very dangerous condition for us. We also have an extra claw called an dew claw. When we’re chasing down a prey, we hook this claw around their legs to topple them over. We can do this running at our top speed. Cheetahs are recognizable by our black spots and they sure do suit us.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E17 - Crocodile
programme.desc: I am an alligator. No, not a crocodile - an alligator. When I got out of my egg I found myself in Australia which is the place where some of the biggest crocodiles in the world live. But they also live in other parts of the world too. And why are people afraid of crocodiles? Find out for yourself.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E18 - Echidna
programme.desc: Hello - I'm an echidna - some people call us spiny anteaters. When I was born I came out of my Mum's pouch. No, my spines didn't hurt her because I hatched from an egg and she kept me warm inside her pouch until I was ready to come out. It takes many days and nights, but a little echidna doesn’t really notice the time passing, because it’s hidden away. Whilst waiting Mum will dig a nursery den in the ground, into which she’ll put her growing baby and once the baby is fully developed it can go explore the world. Adventures await!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E19 - Kangaroo
programme.desc: We love our home in Australia. We love all types of grass, but there are some types we prefer more. Oh did I mention we love to jump? Every part of a kangaroo’s body is perfectly suited for skillful jumping. What is also special about us is that when we are small our mom carries us in her pouch isn’t that cool?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E20 - Kestrel
programme.desc: Hello! I’m a kestrel and I’ve a got a great view from our nest. My mummy is flying around here, somewhere. Kestrels are predators, which mean we eat meat. But we only hunt for things that are smaller than us – like voles, mice, and even some insects. We settle in hollow trees or something similar and lay our eggs. From that point, it takes less than a month for us little kestrels to hatch.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E21 - Turtle
programme.desc: Turtle Mum usually just lays her eggs and leaves. Once we hatch, we have to take care of ourselves. From the moment we hatch, we know everything we need to know. We know what to do, where the ocean is, how to swim, and how to walk. Our goal is to get into the water. In the ocean, we are agile, and great swimmers. We’re better at swimming than crawling around on land.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E22 - Zebra
programme.desc: Hello I’m a little zebra. You say you already know about me? I live in Africa. It’s nice and warm here, I like it a lot. Also, other animals live here with us and there is always something exciting going on. We are black and white and have stripes. When we come to waterholes we must be careful not to meet the crocodile because he would want to eat us. Even when there are a lot of us, we still walk together. We love to roll in the dust!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E23 - My Friends From the Air
programme.desc: There are many birds in the world. You can hear their chattering, singing, cawing, and cackling across every continent. Do you think they will ever learn how to sing properly? And there are so many! Why don’t they ever crash? Lets learn more about our bird friends!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E24 - My Friends From Water
programme.desc: Take a deep breath and let’s go under water. There are so many things and creatures to explore. There are all sorts of shapes and colours, and different ways of life. Each living thing: Humans and animals on dry land, fish living in water, birds, plants, and even insects - are all different. But most of us have three things in common: we breathe oxygen, eat, and breed. Let's look at some of our water animal friends.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E25 - My Friends From Savannah
programme.desc: A new day has begun on the savannah. Herds of gazelle, antelope, zebra, and all kinds of other animals move around to find fresh areas to graze. There are many species of animals living in Africa. They live on the seemingly endless plains of the savannah. Many animals you know from the zoo, live here in the wild. These wild animals like their freedom. They don’t need us to take care of them. They live freely in the wilderness.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E26 - My Best Friends
programme.desc: Today we will remind everyone of what we’ve learned in all the previous episodes, about the different lives of our animal friends. They are all here. The koala, turtle, cheetah, crocodile, bear, zebra and the butterfly...what do you remember about them?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.
